title: Know your safe route
description: All family members should know the safe route to the nearest shelter or raised pucca house.

title: Keep an emergency kit ready
description: Include torch, spare batteries, dry food, drinking water, first-aid, waterproof bags, salt and sugar.

title: Follow official flood warnings
description: Tune to local radio/TV. Keep vigil on warnings from local authorities. Ignore rumours and stay calm.

title: Drink boiled water
description: Keep food covered. Use ORS / rice-water / tender coconut water during diarrhoea and contact health workers.

title: Evacuate safely
description: Pack warm clothes, medicines, valuables and papers in waterproof bags. Inform local volunteers where you are going.

title: Turn off electricity & gas
description: Switch off electrical and gas appliances, and turn off the main power if you have to leave your home.

title: Avoid flood water
description: Do not enter flood waters. Watch for snakes. Keep children away from empty stomach and unsafe areas.

title: Return home carefully
description: Stay away from damaged power lines or buildings. Boil tap water until supplies are declared safe.
